concepts.label: Really? / I don't believe it! / You're so funny!

passages.title: Julia's Winter Week
passages.text: Hi, WOW! readers! I'm Julia. Every winter, my family visits my grandma in the mountains. It's very cold there, and there is lots of snow. We go skiing every morning. I wear warm clothes, gloves and a helmet. My little brother, Leo, can't ski yet, so he goes ice skating with Grandma on the frozen lake. In the afternoon, we sometimes play table tennis indoors because it's too cold outside. At home, I go cycling to school every day, but in the mountains I can't ride my bike on the snowy roads. My favourite winter sport is skiing because it's fast and exciting! What's your favourite winter sport? Write and tell me!

glossary.meaning: things you wear on your hands to keep them warm
so cold that the water is now ice

passages.title: WOW! Interview: Reem's Favourite Sport
passages.text:
WOW!: Hi, Reem. What's your favourite sport?
Reem: It's table tennis. I play with a partner, my cousin Hala.
WOW!: How often do you play?
Reem: We play every Sunday and Tuesday at the sports centre near my school.
WOW!: Do you do any other sports?
Reem: Yes, I do athletics outdoors in the summer. I run every morning before school.
WOW!: Why do you like table tennis?
Reem: Because it's fast, and it helps me focus. You have to watch the ball all the time!
WOW!: Are you learning anything new at the moment?
Reem: Yes, I'm learning to play badminton, but I don't play very often.
WOW!: Thanks, Reem, and good luck!

glossary.meaning: the child of your aunt or uncle
words we say to wish someone success

passages.title: An Email from the Sports Centre
passages.text:
Hi Amani,
How are you? I'm writing this email at the sports centre. It's Saturday, and I'm waiting for my gymnastics class. I do gymnastics every Saturday morning. My brother Faisal usually plays football on Saturdays, but he isn't playing today because he's ill. He's at home, and he's watching cartoons! Right now, my friend Samar is swimming in the big pool. She goes swimming every day before school. Mum is sitting next to me. She doesn't do sports, but she walks in the park every evening. Oh! My teacher is calling my name now. I have to go!
Love,
Nawal

glossary.meaning: a place with water for swimming

passages.title: Sports Day at Our School
passages.text:
Today is Sports Day at our school, and it's very exciting! At the moment, I'm sitting with my class under a big tree. Our teacher, Miss Salma, is helping the younger children with their race. My best friend, Lina, is running in a race now. She does athletics every afternoon, so she's very fast. I don't usually do athletics because I prefer indoor sports. I play table tennis once a week, and I do karate every Wednesday. Oh, look! Our volleyball match is starting now. We're playing against Class 6B, and we don't play volleyball very often, so we're a bit nervous! Wish us luck!
Muna

glossary.meaning: a competition to see who is the fastest

questions.prompt: Look at the picture. Which sport is it?

visual.alt: A player with a long stick and a small ball

hints: Look at what the player is holding.
Which sport uses a long stick?
questions.explanation: In hockey, players hit a small ball with a long stick.
questions.explanationAr: في الهوكي يضرب اللاعبون كرة صغيرة بعصا طويلة 🏑.

wrongWhy.b: Badminton uses a light racket and a net 🏸, not a long stick.
wrongWhy.c: Table tennis uses small bats and a big table 🏓.
wrongWhy.d: Volleyball uses your hands and a big ball over a net 🏐.

questions.prompt: 🤸 Write the missing letters to make the sport: do g y m _ a s t _ c s
questions.pattern: g y m _ a s t _ c s

mistakes.why: The last part is -tics with i, like athletics.
After gym comes n: gym-nas-tics.

hints: Say it slowly: gym … nas … tics.
The last part is like the end of athletics.
questions.explanation: The word is gymnastics: gym + nas + tics. We say do gymnastics.
questions.explanationAr: الكلمة gymnastics وتعني الجمباز، ونقول do gymnastics.

questions.prompt: ⛸️ Unscramble the letters to finish the sport: go ice ________

mistakes.why: Skiing is on snow with two long skis ⛷️. On ice we go ice skating.

hints: The word starts with s and ends with -ing.
It is the sport in the picture ⛸️.
questions.explanation: We go ice skating on ice ⛸️. The word is skating: s-k-a-t-i-n-g.
questions.explanationAr: نقول go ice skating أي التزلّج على الجليد ⛸️.

questions.prompt: Odd one out! Three words are sports. Which word is NOT a sport?
hints: Can you play or do every word?
One word is something you wear.
questions.explanation: A helmet is something we wear on our head to stay safe, for example when we go cycling. It is not a sport.
questions.explanationAr: الخوذة (helmet) نلبسها على الرأس للحماية، وليست رياضة.
questions.tip: helmet = something you wear, not a sport ⛑️

wrongWhy.a: Badminton is a sport: we play badminton.
wrongWhy.b: Athletics is a sport: we do athletics.
wrongWhy.d: Hockey is a sport: we play hockey.

questions.prompt: Listen. Which sport does the speaker's sister do?
questions.audio: My sister loves the water. She goes swimming every Saturday.
hints: Where does she love to be?
questions.explanation: The speaker says his sister loves the water and goes swimming every Saturday.
questions.explanationAr: قال إن أخته تحب الماء وتذهب للسباحة كل سبت 🏊.

wrongWhy.b: Skiing is on snow, but she loves the water.
wrongWhy.c: Cycling is on a bike, not in water.
wrongWhy.d: Ice skating is on ice, not in water.

questions.prompt: Listen. What is Hamed's favourite sport?
questions.audio: My favourite sport is badminton. I play it with my dad in the garden.
questions.explanation: Hamed says: My favourite sport is badminton. He plays it with his dad.
questions.explanationAr: حامد قال إن رياضته المفضّلة هي الريشة الطائرة 🏸 ويلعبها مع أبيه.

wrongWhy.b: Table tennis is played at a big table. Hamed doesn't say table tennis.
wrongWhy.c: Volleyball is a team sport. Hamed plays with his dad.
wrongWhy.d: Hockey is played with long sticks. Hamed doesn't say hockey.

questions.prompt: Match each sport with the things you need for it.

pairs.right: snow, warm clothes and two long skis
a bike with two wheels and a helmet
small bats, a small ball and a big table
a team, a big ball and a net

hints: Start with the easiest one: which sport needs a table?
questions.explanation: Each sport needs different things: skis for skiing, a bike for cycling, bats and a table for table tennis, and a team with a net for volleyball.
questions.explanationAr: كل رياضة تحتاج أدوات مختلفة: زلاجات للتزلّج، دراجة للدراجة، مضارب وطاولة لكرة الطاولة، وفريق وشبكة للكرة الطائرة.
questions.tip: Think: What do I hold? Where do I play?

questions.prompt: Sort the sports. Do we say go, play or do?
hints: Look at the end of the word: does it end in -ing?
Is there a ball in the game?
questions.explanation: go + sports ending in -ing (go scooting). play + games with a ball (play basketball). do + karate, gymnastics and athletics.
questions.explanationAr: go مع الرياضات المنتهية بـ ing، وplay مع ألعاب الكرة، وdo مع karate وgymnastics وathletics.
questions.tip: -ing → go · ball game → play · karate/gymnastics/athletics → do

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word.
questions.sentence: Julia and her brother ___ ice skating in the winter.
hints: Look at the end of the word skating.
How many people are in the sentence?
questions.explanation: Skating ends in -ing, so we say go ice skating. Julia and her brother = they, so we use go.
questions.explanationAr: skating تنتهي بـ ing فنقول go، والفاعل اثنان (they) فلا نضيف es.

wrongWhy.b: We use play with ball games, like play hockey.
wrongWhy.c: We use do with karate, gymnastics and athletics.
wrongWhy.d: goes is for one person (he/she). Julia and her brother are two people.

questions.prompt: True or false? This sentence is correct: 'I do swimming every Saturday.'
hints: Look at the end of the word swimming.
questions.explanation: The correct sentence is: I go swimming every Saturday. We use go with sports that end in -ing.
questions.explanationAr: الصحيح: I go swimming every Saturday، لأن swimming تنتهي بـ ing فنستخدم go.
questions.tip: go swimming 🏊 · go cycling 🚴 · go skiing ⛷️
questions.wrongWhy: Swimming ends in -ing, so we say go swimming, not do swimming.

questions.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word: 'We play gymnastics at school on Tuesdays.'

mistakes.why: We use go with -ing sports, like go cycling. Gymnastics doesn't end in -ing.
We is more than one person, so we use do, not does.

hints: Gymnastics is in the same group as karate.
questions.explanation: We say do gymnastics. The correct sentence is: We do gymnastics at school on Tuesdays.
questions.explanationAr: نقول do gymnastics، فالصحيح: We do gymnastics at school on Tuesdays.
questions.tip: do karate 🥋 · do gymnastics 🤸 · do athletics 🏃

questions.prompt: Which sports go with play? Choose all.
hints: Which ones are games with a ball?
questions.explanation: We play volleyball, play hockey and play badminton. But we go cycling and do karate.
questions.explanationAr: نقول play volleyball وplay hockey وplay badminton، لكن go cycling وdo karate.

questions.prompt: Listen. Which verb does Samar use with her sport?
questions.audio: Hi, I'm Samar. Every Tuesday, I do gymnastics in the big gym at school.
hints: Listen to the word just before the sport.
questions.explanation: Samar says: I do gymnastics. We always use do with gymnastics.
questions.explanationAr: سمر قالت I do gymnastics، ونستخدم do دائمًا مع الجمباز.

wrongWhy.b: go is for -ing sports like go cycling. Samar's sport is gymnastics.
wrongWhy.c: play is for ball games. Gymnastics is not a ball game.
wrongWhy.d: make is not used with sports in this unit.

questions.prompt: Four friends talk about their sports. Who is correct?
hints: Check each sport: does it end in -ing?
questions.explanation: Cycling ends in -ing, so go cycling is correct.
questions.explanationAr: cycling تنتهي بـ ing فنقول go cycling، وهذه الجملة الصحيحة.

wrongWhy.a: Volleyball is a ball game, so we say play volleyball.
wrongWhy.b: We say do karate, not play karate.
wrongWhy.d: Table tennis is a ball game, so we say play table tennis.

questions.prompt: Read what each child says. Is the sport indoors or outdoors?

items.text: We play with small bats on a big table.
I need lots of snow on the mountains.
I ride my bike on the road to school.
I wear white clothes and no shoes in the sports hall.
I push my scooter along the street.

hints: Find a place word in each sentence: table, mountains, road, hall, street.
Is that place inside a building?
questions.explanation: Table tennis and karate happen inside a building. Skiing, cycling and scooting happen outside.
questions.explanationAr: كرة الطاولة والكاراتيه داخل المبنى، أما التزلّج والدراجة والسكوتر ففي الخارج.

questions.prompt: It's raining today 🌧️. Arwa wants to do a sport inside. Which sport can she do?
hints: Which sport do we usually do in a gym?
questions.explanation: Gymnastics is an indoor sport. We usually do it in a gym, so the rain is not a problem.
questions.explanationAr: الجمباز رياضة داخلية نمارسها في الصالة، فالمطر لا يمنعها.

wrongWhy.b: Cycling is usually outdoors on the road, so she gets wet.
wrongWhy.c: Skiing is outdoors on snowy mountains.
wrongWhy.d: Scooting is outdoors on the street.

questions.prompt: Think about Arlo's WOW! Quiz clue. True or false? Arlo plays his other team sport only indoors.
hints: Where does Arlo play in the winter?
questions.explanation: Arlo's team sport is volleyball. He plays it indoors in winter and outdoors on the beach in summer.
questions.explanationAr: رياضة آرلو هي الكرة الطائرة، يلعبها في الصالة شتاءً وعلى الشاطئ صيفًا، فليست داخلية فقط.
questions.tip: Volleyball 🏐: indoors in winter, outdoors in summer
questions.wrongWhy: Arlo plays it indoors in the gym in the winter, but outdoors on the beach in the summer. So it is not only indoors.

questions.prompt: Listen. Where is Majid's sport today?
questions.audio: It's very hot outside today, so I'm not going cycling. I'm playing table tennis at the sports centre.
questions.explanation: Majid is playing table tennis at the sports centre. That is inside a building, so it is indoors.
questions.explanationAr: ماجد يلعب كرة الطاولة في المركز الرياضي، أي في الداخل.

wrongWhy.b: Majid is not going cycling outside today because it's very hot.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word.
questions.sentence: In the summer, we play volleyball ___ on the beach.
hints: Is the beach inside or outside?
questions.explanation: The beach is outside, so we play volleyball outdoors there.
questions.explanationAr: الشاطئ في الخارج، لذلك نقول outdoors.

wrongWhy.b: indoors means inside a building. The beach is outside.
wrongWhy.c: A gym is a building. The sentence says on the beach.

questions.prompt: 🏠 Unscramble the word to complete the sentence.
questions.sentence: We usually do karate and gymnastics ___ in a sports hall.

mistakes.why: outdoors means outside. A sports hall is inside a building.

hints: A sports hall is inside a building.
questions.explanation: A sports hall is inside a building, so the word is indoors.
questions.explanationAr: الصالة الرياضية داخل مبنى، فالكلمة indoors أي في الداخل.

questions.prompt: Which sports have wheels? Choose all.
hints: Look at the pictures. Can you see wheels?
questions.explanation: A bike and a scooter have wheels. Skates and skis go on ice and snow without wheels.
questions.explanationAr: الدراجة والسكوتر لهما عجلات، أما التزلّج فعلى الجليد والثلج.

questions.prompt: Sort the sports: team sport or winter sport?
hints: Which sports need snow or ice?
questions.explanation: Volleyball, hockey and basketball are played by teams. Skiing and ice skating need snow or ice, so they are winter sports.
questions.explanationAr: الكرة الطائرة والهوكي وكرة السلة رياضات جماعية، والتزلّج على الثلج والجليد رياضات شتوية.
questions.tip: 👥 team = many players together · ❄️ winter = snow or ice

questions.prompt: Odd one out! Which sport is different from the other three?
hints: What is the same about three of them?
questions.explanation: Volleyball, hockey and football are team sports with a ball. Karate is not a team sport and has no ball.
questions.explanationAr: الكرة الطائرة والهوكي وكرة القدم رياضات جماعية بالكرة، أما الكاراتيه فليست كذلك.
questions.tip: Find the group first, then the odd one.

wrongWhy.a: Volleyball is a team sport, like hockey and football.
wrongWhy.b: Hockey is a team sport, like volleyball and football.
wrongWhy.c: Football is a team sport, like volleyball and hockey.

questions.prompt: Read the clue and write the sport: 'I am a winter sport. You go down a snowy mountain on two long skis.'

mistakes.why: Skating is on ice with skates. On a snowy mountain with skis we go skiing.
Skiing has two i's: ski + ing.

questions.explanation: Skis + snow + mountain = skiing. We say go skiing.
questions.explanationAr: الزلاجات والثلج والجبل = skiing، ونقول go skiing.

questions.prompt: True or false? Ice skating is a winter sport.
hints: What do you need for ice skating?
questions.explanation: Ice skating happens on ice, so it is a winter sport, like skiing.
questions.explanationAr: التزلّج على الجليد رياضة شتوية مثل التزلّج على الثلج.
questions.wrongWhy: Ice skating needs ice, and ice comes with cold winter weather, so it is a winter sport.

questions.prompt: Listen to Samar's clue. What is her favourite sport?
questions.audio: My favourite sport is a team sport. We play it outdoors on grass. We use long sticks and a small ball.
questions.evidence: We use long sticks and a small ball
questions.explanation: A team sport with long sticks and a small ball is hockey.
questions.explanationAr: رياضة جماعية بعصي طويلة وكرة صغيرة = الهوكي 🏑.

wrongWhy.b: Badminton is not usually a team sport, and we don't use long sticks.
wrongWhy.c: Volleyball is a team sport, but we use our hands and a big ball.
wrongWhy.d: Table tennis uses small bats and a table, not long sticks.

questions.prompt: True or false? Julia's brother goes skiing every morning.
questions.evidence: can't ski yet, so he goes ice skating
hints: Find the name of Julia's brother.
questions.explanation: Julia says Leo can't ski yet, so he goes ice skating on the frozen lake.
questions.explanationAr: جوليا قالت إن أخاها لا يستطيع التزلّج بعد، لذلك يتزلّج على الجليد مع جدّته.
questions.wrongWhy: Leo can't ski yet. He goes ice skating with Grandma. Julia's family goes skiing.

questions.prompt: Why do they sometimes play table tennis indoors?
hints: Find the words table tennis in the text.
questions.explanation: Julia says they play table tennis indoors because it's too cold outside.
questions.explanationAr: لأن الجو بارد جدًّا في الخارج.

wrongWhy.b: Leo can't ski, but that is why he goes ice skating, not why they play indoors.
wrongWhy.c: The text doesn't say what Grandma likes.
wrongWhy.d: There is lots of snow in the mountains.

questions.prompt: What is the best title for Julia's post?
questions.evidence: My favourite winter sport is skiing
hints: Where is Julia, and what is the weather like?
Which title is about the whole text?
questions.explanation: The post is about winter sports in the snowy mountains, so 'Fun in the Snow' is the best title.
questions.explanationAr: النص عن رياضات الشتاء في الجبال المثلجة، فأفضل عنوان Fun in the Snow.
questions.tip: Best title = what the whole text is about

wrongWhy.b: Julia is on holiday in the mountains, not at school.
wrongWhy.c: It's winter and it's very cold, not summer on the beach.
wrongWhy.d: Julia doesn't talk about hockey.

questions.prompt: Which sports does Julia do in the mountains? Choose all.
questions.explanation: Julia goes skiing every morning, and they sometimes play table tennis. Leo goes ice skating, and Julia can't cycle on the snowy roads.
questions.explanationAr: جوليا تتزلّج على الثلج وتلعب كرة الطاولة أحيانًا. التزلّج على الجليد لأخيها، والدراجة في بلدها فقط.
questions.tip: Who does it? Where? Read carefully!

questions.prompt: Listen to the clue. What sport is it?
questions.audio: This sport has wheels. You stand on it and push with one foot. Don't forget your helmet!
questions.evidence: You stand on it and push with one foot
questions.explanation: You stand on a scooter and push with one foot. It has wheels and you wear a helmet.
questions.explanationAr: نقف على السكوتر وندفعه بقدم واحدة، وله عجلات ونلبس خوذة.

wrongWhy.b: A bike has wheels, but you sit on it and use pedals.
wrongWhy.c: Skiing has no wheels. You go on snow.
wrongWhy.d: Gymnastics has no wheels and no helmet.

questions.prompt: Read each clue and match it with the sport.

pairs.left: I wear white clothes and no shoes. I don't need a ball.
I run and jump outdoors in the summer.
I hit a light ball with feathers over a high net with a racket.
I wear warm clothes and go fast on the ice.

hints: Find the key word in each clue.
Which clue has the word ice?
questions.explanation: Karate: white clothes, no shoes. Athletics: running and jumping. Badminton: racket and net. Ice skating: on the ice.
questions.explanationAr: الكاراتيه: ملابس بيضاء بلا حذاء. ألعاب القوى: جري وقفز. الريشة: مضرب وشبكة. التزلّج على الجليد: على الجليد.
questions.tip: Look for the key words: clothes, net, ice, run.

questions.prompt: Put the events of Team Talk in order.

items.text: Sultan is reading the WOW! Quiz in the park.
Arlo says he goes scooting every day.
Sultan says he plays football at the weekends.
Sultan remembers it's Monday, his karate day.
Arlo starts doing karate in the park.

hints: What is Sultan doing at the start?
What happens at the very end?
questions.explanation: First Sultan reads the quiz, then Arlo talks about his sports, then Sultan talks about his sports, then he remembers karate, and at the end Arlo does karate.
questions.explanationAr: سلطان يقرأ المسابقة، ثم يتكلم آرلو عن رياضاته، ثم سلطان عن رياضاته، ثم يتذكّر الكاراتيه، وأخيرًا يمارس آرلو الكاراتيه.

questions.prompt: In Team Talk, why does Sultan say 'I have to go'?

options.text: Because it's Monday, and he does karate every Monday.
Because he plays football at the weekends.
Because he doesn't like Arlo's jokes.
Because he wants to go swimming.

hints: What does Sultan do every Monday?
questions.explanation: Sultan does karate every Monday, and he says 'That's today!' So he has to go to karate.
questions.explanationAr: سلطان يمارس الكاراتيه كل يوم اثنين، واليوم هو الاثنين، فيجب أن يذهب.

wrongWhy.b: Football is at the weekends. Today is Monday.
wrongWhy.c: Sultan likes Arlo. He laughs and says he's so funny.
wrongWhy.d: Swimming is Arlo's sport, not Sultan's.

questions.prompt: True or false? In Team Talk, Sultan prefers outdoor sports.
hints: Are karate and gymnastics indoors or outdoors?
questions.explanation: Sultan says: I prefer indoor sports like karate and gymnastics.
questions.explanationAr: سلطان قال إنه يفضّل الرياضات الداخلية مثل الكاراتيه والجمباز.
questions.wrongWhy: Sultan plays football at the weekends, but he prefers indoor sports like karate and gymnastics.

questions.prompt: Which sports does Arlo do? Choose all.
questions.explanation: Arlo plays basketball every week, sometimes goes swimming, and does karate too. Football and gymnastics are Sultan's sports.
questions.explanationAr: آرلو يلعب كرة السلة ويسبح أحيانًا ويمارس الكاراتيه. كرة القدم والجمباز رياضات سلطان.

questions.prompt: Listen to Arlo. Where does he go swimming?
questions.audio: I sometimes go swimming indoors at the sports centre.
questions.explanation: Arlo says he goes swimming indoors at the sports centre.
questions.explanationAr: آرلو قال إنه يسبح في الداخل في المركز الرياضي.

wrongWhy.b: The beach is where Arlo plays volleyball in the summer.
wrongWhy.c: Arlo and Sultan talk in the park, but Arlo doesn't swim there.
wrongWhy.d: Arlo goes to school by scooter. He doesn't say he swims there.

questions.prompt: True or false? Sultan says 'You're so funny!' because Arlo starts doing karate in the park.
hints: What does Arlo say just before?
questions.explanation: Arlo does karate right there in the park, so Sultan laughs and says: You're so funny!
questions.explanationAr: آرلو بدأ يمارس الكاراتيه في الحديقة، فضحك سلطان وقال: You're so funny!
questions.tip: Something makes you laugh → You're so funny! 😄
questions.wrongWhy: Arlo says 'Look! I'm doing it now!' and does karate in the park. That makes Sultan laugh.

questions.prompt: Listen to Sultan. How often does he do gymnastics?
questions.audio: I do gymnastics once a week and I do karate every Monday.
questions.evidence: I do gymnastics once a week
hints: Two sports are in the sentence.
Listen to the words after gymnastics.
questions.explanation: Sultan says: I do gymnastics once a week.
questions.explanationAr: سلطان قال: أمارس الجمباز مرة في الأسبوع.
questions.tip: once a week = مرة في الأسبوع

wrongWhy.b: Sultan doesn't say every day.
wrongWhy.c: Every Monday is for karate, not gymnastics.
wrongWhy.d: At the weekends is when Sultan plays football.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to make a question.
questions.explanation: How often + do + you + verb …? → How often do you go cycling?
questions.explanationAr: نكوّن السؤال: How often + do + you + الفعل: How often do you go cycling?

questions.prompt: Choose the best question word.
questions.sentence: A: ___ do you play football?  B: At the weekends.
hints: Look at the answer B gives.
Is the answer a place, a person or a time?
questions.explanation: The answer 'At the weekends' tells us when and how many times, so the question is How often.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة At the weekends تخبرنا كم مرة، فالسؤال How often.
questions.tip: How often? → every day / once a week / at the weekends

wrongWhy.b: What asks about a thing, like 'What sport do you play?'
wrongWhy.c: Where asks about a place, like 'In the park.'
wrongWhy.d: Who asks about a person, like 'With my brother.'

questions.prompt: Which is the best answer to this question?
questions.sentence: How often do you go cycling? ___
hints: What does How often ask about?
Find the answer with a time word.
questions.explanation: How often asks how many times, so 'Every day' is the right answer.
questions.explanationAr: How often تسأل عن عدد المرات، فالإجابة Every day.

wrongWhy.b: 'In the park' answers Where? not How often?
wrongWhy.c: 'With my brother' answers Who with? not How often?
wrongWhy.d: 'Yes, I do' answers a Do you…? question, not How often?

questions.prompt: Look at Samar's table. How often does Samar do karate?
questions.explanation: Karate is only on Sunday, one day in the week. So Samar does karate once a week.
questions.explanationAr: الكاراتيه يوم الأحد فقط، أي مرة واحدة في الأسبوع.
questions.tip: 1 day a week = once a week

wrongWhy.b: Swimming is every day. Karate is only on Sunday.
wrongWhy.c: Volleyball is at the weekends (Friday and Saturday).
wrongWhy.d: There is no karate on Friday.

questions.prompt: Your friend says: 'I can ski, skate and swim, and I'm only six!' You are very surprised. What do you say?

questions.prompt: Match each situation with the best expression.

Your friend says something strange, and you want to check.
Your friend says something amazing, and you are very, very surprised.

hints: Which one is a short question?

wrongWhy.b: Hamed isn't talking about a habit, so How often? doesn't fit.
wrongWhy.c: Hamed didn't ask a Do you…? question.
wrongWhy.d: This doesn't answer what Hamed is doing.

questions.prompt: What does 'I don't believe it!' show?
hints: Sultan says it when Arlo says he does karate, too.

wrongWhy.b: Tired means you want to rest. The expression is about surprise.

questions.prompt: Write an interview with a friend about their favourite sport. Write the questions and the answers.
guide: How often do you do it?
questions.starter: Me: Hi, Sara. What's your favourite sport?
frame: Friend: I … every … / once a week.
Me: Why do you like it?
questions.model:
Me: Hi, Sara. What's your favourite sport?
Sara: It's volleyball. I play in a team with my friends.
Me: How often do you play?
Sara: I play every Monday and Wednesday after school.
Me: Where do you play?
Sara: I play indoors in the gym in the winter and outdoors on the beach in the summer.
Me: Why do you like it?
Sara: Because it's fun and it's important to be healthy.
Me: Are you learning anything new?
Sara: Yes, I'm learning to play badminton!
hints: Use the guide questions in order.
questions.explanation: A good interview has questions with How often, Where and Why, and full answers with time words like every week.
questions.explanationAr: المقابلة الجيدة فيها أسئلة How often وWhere وWhy وإجابات كاملة بكلمات الوقت.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to make a sentence.

questions.prompt: True or false? This sentence has the correct capital letters: 'sultan does karate every monday.'

questions.prompt: Look at this question: 'how often you go cycling.' Which mistakes can you find? Choose all.

questions.explanationAr: الصحيح: How often do you go cycling? حرف كبير وdo وعلامة استفهام. كلمة cycling صحيحة.

questions.prompt: Write the question for this answer. Use How often. Answer: 'I go swimming once a week.'

how often do you go swimming ?

questions.explanation: The answer is about how many times, so the question is: How often do you go swimming?

questions.tip: How often + do + you + go swimming?

questions.prompt: Choose the best linking word.

questions.prompt: Find the mistake and write the correct word: 'Sultan play football at the weekends.'

mistakes.why: This is a habit (at the weekends), so we need Present simple, not -ing.

questions.prompt: Listen to three children. Who is talking about a habit?

wrongWhy.c: Arlo = he, so we add -es: goes.

questions.prompt: Listen. Is Dad talking about a habit or about now?

wrongWhy.d: The speaker doesn't say scooting.

Samar is swimming in the big pool.
Nawal is waiting for her class.

questions.explanation: Sentences with every… and no -ing are habits. Sentences with is + -ing are happening now.
questions.explanationAr: الجمل التي فيها every بدون ing عادات، والتي فيها is + ing تحدث الآن.

questions.prompt: Why is Muna's class a bit nervous?

questions.prompt: Write a message to a friend. Tell her about your sports routine and what you are doing right now.
guide: How often do you do them?
What are you doing at the moment?
What is your family doing now?
questions.starter: Hi Reem, I'm writing this message at home.
questions.model:
Hi Reem,
I'm writing this message at home. I usually go swimming once a week at the sports centre, and I play volleyball at the weekends. I also do karate every Monday. But today I'm not doing sports because it's raining. At the moment I'm sitting in my room, and my brother is watching cartoons. What are you doing now?
Love,
Aleen
hints: Then write what you are doing now.
questions.explanation: A good message uses the Present simple for routines (I go swimming once a week) and the Present continuous for now (I'm sitting in my room).
questions.explanationAr: استخدمي Present simple للروتين وPresent continuous لما يحدث الآن.

questions.prompt: Sort the time words. Which tense do they usually go with?

questions.explanation: Habit words (every, once a week, after school, at the weekends) go with the Present simple. now, at the moment and today go with the Present continuous.
questions.explanationAr: كلمات العادة مع Present simple، وnow وat the moment وtoday مع Present continuous.
questions.tip: 🔁 every… · ⏱️ now / at the moment / today

questions.tip: isn't …ing → today / now / at the moment

wrongWhy.b: every week is a habit word. It goes with the Present simple.

questions.prompt: Complete the time words. Shh! The baby is sleeping at the ___.

questions.prompt: Which time words go with the Present simple? Choose all.

now and at the moment are about this time.
questions.explanation: every day, once a week and at the weekends show habits, so they go with the Present simple.
questions.explanationAr: every day وonce a week وat the weekends كلمات عادة.

questions.explanation: Nawal writes: he isn't playing today because he's ill.
questions.explanationAr: فيصل لا يلعب اليوم لأنه مريض.
questions.wrongWhy: Faisal usually plays football on Saturdays, but today he isn't playing because he's ill.

questions.prompt: What is Faisal watching at home? Write one word.

mistakes.why: Faisal isn't playing football today. Read what he is doing at home.

questions.explanation: Nawal writes: He's at home, and he's watching cartoons!
questions.explanationAr: فيصل يشاهد الرسوم المتحركة في البيت.

questions.prompt: What is Lina doing now?
questions.evidence: is running in a race now
questions.explanation: Muna writes: My best friend, Lina, is running in a race now.
questions.explanationAr: لينا تجري في سباق الآن.
questions.tip: Find the name, then the -ing verb.

wrongWhy.b: Muna is sitting under the tree with her class.
wrongWhy.c: Muna plays table tennis once a week.
wrongWhy.d: Miss Salma is helping the younger children.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word to start the question.
questions.sentence: ___ Sultan play football at the weekends?
hints: Is the verb play or playing?
questions.explanation: Present simple question with he: Does + Sultan + play …?
questions.explanationAr: سؤال Present simple مع he يبدأ بـ Does.

wrongWhy.b: Do is for I, you, we and they. Sultan = he.
wrongWhy.c: Is goes with an -ing verb: Is Sultan playing…?
wrongWhy.d: Are is for you, we and they with -ing.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct short answer.
hints: The answer uses the same helper as the question.
questions.explanation: Sultan doesn't play volleyball, and a Does question gets a does/doesn't answer: No, he doesn't.
questions.explanationAr: سلطان لا يلعب الكرة الطائرة، والسؤال بـ Does فالجواب No, he doesn't.
questions.tip: Does…? → Yes, he does. / No, he doesn't.

wrongWhy.b: Sultan plays football, karate and gymnastics. Volleyball is Arlo's sport.
wrongWhy.c: The question starts with Does, so the answer uses does/doesn't.
wrongWhy.d: With he we say doesn't, not don't.

questions.prompt: Look at the picture of Reem right now. Is Reem playing table tennis now?
hints: What is Reem doing in the picture?
questions.explanation: Reem is running now, not playing table tennis. An Is question gets an is/isn't answer: No, she isn't.
questions.explanationAr: ريم تجري الآن، والسؤال بـ Is فالجواب No, she isn't.
questions.tip: Is…? → Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.

wrongWhy.b: The question starts with Is, so the answer uses is/isn't, not doesn't.
wrongWhy.c: In the picture Reem is running, not playing table tennis.
wrongWhy.d: Reem isn't playing table tennis now, and an Is question needs is/isn't.

questions.prompt: Put the words in order to make a question.
hints: A question starts with the helper.
The time words go at the end.
questions.explanation: Present continuous question: Are + they + verb-ing …? → Are they doing gymnastics at the moment?
questions.explanationAr: سؤال Present continuous: Are + they + الفعل مع ing.

questions.prompt: Match each question with the correct short answer.

pairs.left: Do they go skiing in winter?

hints: Look at the first word of each question.
Find the answer with the same word.
questions.explanation: The short answer uses the same helper as the question: Does → does, Is → is, Do → do, Are → are.
questions.explanationAr: الإجابة القصيرة تستخدم نفس الفعل المساعد في السؤال.

questions.prompt: Listen. What is the boy's brother doing?
questions.audio: Girl: Is your brother playing football now? Boy: No, he isn't. He's doing his homework.
questions.explanation: The boy says: No, he isn't. He's doing his homework.
questions.explanationAr: أخوه لا يلعب كرة القدم، بل يكتب واجبه.
questions.tip: No, he isn't. → then listen for what he IS doing

wrongWhy.b: The boy says: No, he isn't playing football.
wrongWhy.c: The boy says doing, but doing his homework, not karate.
wrongWhy.d: Swimming isn't in the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Make a Present simple question with these words: Sultan / do karate / every Monday
questions.answer: Does Sultan do karate every Monday?
accept: Does Sultan do karate every Monday

mistakes.answer: Do Sultan do karate every Monday?
mistakes.why: Sultan = he, so we start with Does, not Do.

mistakes.answer: Does Sultan does karate every Monday?
mistakes.why: After Does, the verb goes back to do: Does Sultan do…?

mistakes.answer: Is Sultan doing karate every Monday?
mistakes.why: every Monday is a habit, so we use the Present simple with Does.

hints: After Sultan, use do, not does.
questions.explanation: Does + Sultan + do + karate + every Monday? (Yes, he does.)
questions.explanationAr: Does + Sultan + do karate + every Monday?
